definitions.gloss: to estimate, to assess, to calculate roughly
definitions.explanation: To roughly calculate the cost, amount, time, or value of something. Commonly used in business for making cost estimates and quotations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見積|みつ}もる。
⟦{被害|ひがい}{額|がく}→被害額：30556_higaigaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一億|いちおく}→一億：08929_ichioku⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{見積|みつ}もられて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The damage is estimated at 100 million yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{多|おお}め→多め：28421_oome⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見積|みつ}もっておいたほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{安心|あんしん}→安心：01288_anshin⟧だ。
examples.english: It's safer to estimate on the generous side when it comes to time.

notes:
USAGE:
The noun form ⟦{見積|みつ}もり→見積もり：05153_mitsumori⟧ (estimate, quotation) is extremely common in business. It can also be written {見積|みつ}り. The expressions ⟦{多|おお}め→多め：28421_oome⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見積|みつ}もる (to overestimate) and ⟦{少|すく}なめ→少なめ：19120_sukuname⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見積|みつ}もる (to underestimate) are frequently used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見積|みつ}もる: to estimate costs
- ⟦{多|おお}め→多め：28421_oome⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見積|みつ}もる: to estimate on the high side
- ⟦{少|すく}なめ→少なめ：19120_sukuname⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見積|みつ}もる: to estimate on the low side
- ～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{見積|みつ}もられる: to be estimated at...
- ⟦{見積|みつ}もり→見積もり：05153_mitsumori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to give a quotation
